scanNote:
15-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (107-bet) - INTERNETNING AFZALLIK VA KAMChILIKLARI.

Yuqorida o'ngda YaShIL yorliqda oq '15', chapida 'Surf the Net!'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
11) 'Do you use the Internet? If not, would you like to? Which of these things do you (or would you like to) use the Internet for?' Qiya: 'finding information, playing games, joining chat groups, on-line shopping, sending e-mail, joining newsgroups'.
12) 'Read the list of points about the Internet and mark them A (advantage) or D (disadvantage). Then, act out short dialogues in pairs, as in the example.' 1 Web pages with photographs, music and video make downloading slow and boring. 2 The latest information is available to you at any time, quickly and easily. 3 On-line shopping can save you time and money. 4 With so much information, finding what you want can take hours. 5 You can share your hobbies and special interests with newsgroups and chat groups. 6 There is too much advertising instead of real information. 7 You can make new friends in chat groups. 8 Making 'chat friends' is not the same as actually meeting people. 9 You can send mail fast and cheaply. Ko'k qiya: 'SA: One of the disadvantages of using the Internet is that web pages with photographs, music and video make downloading slow and boring. SB: I agree, but on the other hand, the latest information is available to you at any time, quickly and easily.'
13) a) 'Read the article and fill in the gaps with words and phrases from the list.' Qiya: 'but, Finally, Firstly, For example, However, In conclusion, Also, What is more, On the other hand'. Kasseta belgisi: b) 'Listen and check your answers.' c) 'Read the article again and answer the questions, then explain the words in bold.'

O'NG USTUN:
   Savollar: 1 Which paragraph is about the advantages of using the Internet? 2 Which paragraph is about the disadvantages of using the Internet? 3 In which paragraph does the writer sum up the pros and cons? How does this paragraph start? 4 Which paragraph introduces the topic? 5 Is the article for or against using the Internet?
   VARAQA 'The Pros and Cons of Using the Internet' (surat: rul ushlagan erkak, 'BAD LINK' yozuvlari):
   1: 'Advertisements for the Internet promise you a world of information, ENTERTAINMENT, on-line shopping and e-mail services. (1) ......, the real world of the Internet may not be as perfect as the advertisements SUGGEST.'
   2: 'Using the Internet offers many advantages. (2) ......, all of the latest information is available to you, in your home, at any hour of the day or night. It is much faster and easier to surf the net IN SEARCH OF information from all over the world than to travel to LIBRARIES in DOZENS of countries. (3) ......, on-line shopping makes it possible to search through CATALOGUES to find exactly what you want at the best price, saving both time and money. By joining a newsgroup or chat group, you can share your hobbies and special interests, and perhaps make friends all over the world. (4) ......, e-mail is popular because it is faster than sending a letter and cheaper than a telephone conversation.'
   3: '(5) ......, the Internet has several disadvantages. (6) ......, with so much information available, finding what you want can take you hours. MULTIMEDIA web pages with photographs, music and video are attractive, (7) ...... they make downloading slow and boring. (8) ......, there is too much advertising instead of real information. As for Internet FRIENDSHIPS, sitting at home in front of a computer making 'CHAT FRIENDS' is not the same as actually meeting people.'
   4: '(9) ......, the Internet OBVIOUSLY has both good and bad points. Fortunately, the system is improving all the time, and any problems which still EXIST can BE SOLVED. WHETHER WE LIKE IT OR NOT, the Internet is here to stay, so we have to make the best possible use of it.'
• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the article in Ex. 13 again and make notes about the Pros and Cons of using the Internet. Then, use your notes to talk about the topic.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '107'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the list of points about the Internet and mark them A (advantage) or D (disadvantage). Then, act out short dialogues in pairs, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Internet haqidagi fikrlar ro'yxatini o'qing va ularni A (afzallik) yoki D (kamchilik) deb belgilang. Keyin juftlikda qisqa dialoglarni o'ynang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: One of the disadvantages of
      using the Internet is that
      web pages with photographs,
      music and video make
      downloading slow and boring.
  SB: I agree, but on the other
      hand, the latest information
      is available to you at any
      time, quickly and easily.


JAVOBLAR:
  1 D  2 A  3 A  4 D  5 A  6 D
  7 A  8 D  9 A


⚠ 'AN ADVANTAGE':

  = afzallik.
  ⚠ 'a disadvantage' = kamchilik.
  ⚠ 'pros and cons' = afzallik va
  kamchiliklar.


⚠ 'THE LATEST':

  = eng so'nggi.


⚠ 'AVAILABLE':

  = mavjud.


⚠ 'TO SHARE':

  = bo'lishmoq.


⚠ 'ADVERTISING':

  = reklama (umumiy).


⚠ 'ACTUALLY':

  = haqiqatan, aslida.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and fill in the gaps with words and phrases from the list: but, Finally, Firstly, For example, However, In conclusion, Also, What is more, On the other hand. Then listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va bo'sh joylarni ro'yxatdagi so'z va iboralar bilan to'ldiring: but, Finally, Firstly, For example, However, In conclusion, Also, What is more, On the other hand. Keyin tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 However (reklama va'da
    beradi, LEKIN ...)
  2 For example (afzalliklar
    misoli)
  3 Also (yana bir afzallik)
  4 What is more (yana)
  5 On the other hand (kamchiliklar
    boshlanishi)
  6 Firstly (birinchi kamchilik)
  7 but (jozibali, LEKIN sekin)
  8 Finally (oxirgi kamchilik)
  9 In conclusion (xulosa)


BOG'LOVChILAR:

  QARAMA-QARShI: However, but, On
    the other hand
  MISOL: For example
  QO'ShISh: Also, What is more
  SANASh: Firstly, Finally
  XULOSA: In conclusion


⚠ Audio bilan tekshiring.

exercises.instructionEn: The Pros and Cons of Using the Internet
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Internet reklamalari sizga
ma'lumot, ko'ngilochar tadbir, onlayn
xarid va e-mail xizmatlari dunyosini
va'da qiladi. Biroq, Internetning
haqiqiy dunyosi reklamalar
aytganchalik mukammal bo'lmasligi
mumkin.

2) Internetdan foydalanish ko'p
afzalliklar beradi. Masalan, barcha
eng so'nggi ma'lumot sizga uyingizda,
kun yoki tunning istalgan soatida
mavjud. Dunyoning har yeridan
ma'lumot izlab Internetda kezish
o'nlab mamlakatlardagi
kutubxonalarga sayohat qilishdan
ancha tez va oson. Shuningdek,
onlayn xarid kataloglarni ko'rib
chiqib, xohlagan narsangizni eng
yaxshi narxda topish imkonini beradi
- vaqt va pulni tejaydi. Yangiliklar
yoki chat guruhiga qo'shilib, sevimli
mashg'ulot va qiziqishlaringizni
bo'lishishingiz va ehtimol butun
dunyo bo'ylab do'stlar orttirishingiz
mumkin. Bundan tashqari, e-mail
mashhur, chunki u xat yuborishdan
tezroq va telefon suhbatidan
arzonroq.

3) Boshqa tomondan, Internetning bir
nechta kamchiliklari bor.
Birinchidan, shunchalik ko'p
ma'lumot bilan xohlagan narsangizni
topish soatlab vaqt olishi mumkin.
Surat, musiqa va videoli multimedia
veb-sahifalar jozibali, lekin ular
yuklab olishni sekin va zerikarli
qiladi. Nihoyat, haqiqiy ma'lumot
o'rniga juda ko'p reklama bor.
Internet do'stligiga kelsak, uyda
kompyuter oldida o'tirib 'chat
do'stlari' orttirish odamlarni
haqiqatan uchratish bilan bir xil
emas.

4) Xulosa qilib aytganda,
Internetning aniq yaxshi va yomon
tomonlari bor. Baxtimizga, tizim
doimo yaxshilanmoqda va hali mavjud
bo'lgan har qanday muammoni hal
qilish mumkin. Xohlaymizmi-yo'qmi,
Internet qolish uchun keldi, shuning
uchun undan iloji boricha yaxshi
foydalanishimiz kerak.


QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  entertainment = ko'ngilochar
    tadbir
  suggest = aytmoq, ishora qilmoq
  in search of = ... izlab
  libraries = kutubxonalar
  dozens = o'nlab
  catalogues = kataloglar
  multimedia = multimedia
  friendships = do'stliklar
  chat friends = chat do'stlari
  obviously = aniq
  exist = mavjud bo'lmoq
  be solved = hal qilinmoq
  whether we like it or not =
    xohlaymizmi-yo'qmi


⚠ 'PROS AND CONS':

  = afzallik va kamchiliklar.
  (lotincha 'pro' = uchun, 'contra'
  = qarshi)


⚠ 'TO PROMISE':

  = va'da bermoq.


⚠ 'AS PERFECT AS':

  = ...chalik mukammal.


⚠ 'AT ANY HOUR':

  = istalgan soatda.


⚠ 'AS FOR':

  = ...ga kelsak.


⚠ 'HERE TO STAY':

  = qolish uchun keldi (doimiy).


⚠ 'TO MAKE THE BEST USE OF':

  = ...dan eng yaxshi foydalanmoq.

points.en: Advertisements for the Internet promise you a world of information, entertainment, on-line shopping and e-mail services. However, the real world of the Internet may not be as perfect as the advertisements suggest.
points.uz: Internet reklamalari sizga ma'lumot, ko'ngilochar tadbir, onlayn xarid va e-mail xizmatlari dunyosini va'da qiladi. Biroq, Internetning haqiqiy dunyosi reklamalar aytganchalik mukammal bo'lmasligi mumkin.

points.en: Using the Internet offers many advantages. For example, all of the latest information is available to you, in your home, at any hour of the day or night. It is much faster and easier to surf the net in search of information from all over the world than to travel to libraries in dozens of countries.
points.uz: Internetdan foydalanish ko'p afzalliklar beradi. Masalan, barcha eng so'nggi ma'lumot sizga uyingizda, kun yoki tunning istalgan soatida mavjud. Dunyoning har yeridan ma'lumot izlab Internetda kezish o'nlab mamlakatlardagi kutubxonalarga sayohat qilishdan ancha tez va oson.

points.en: Also, on-line shopping makes it possible to search through catalogues to find exactly what you want at the best price, saving both time and money. By joining a newsgroup or chat group, you can share your hobbies and special interests, and perhaps make friends all over the world. What is more, e-mail is popular because it is faster than sending a letter and cheaper than a telephone conversation.
points.uz: Shuningdek, onlayn xarid kataloglarni ko'rib chiqib, xohlagan narsangizni eng yaxshi narxda topish imkonini beradi - vaqt va pulni tejaydi. Yangiliklar yoki chat guruhiga qo'shilib, sevimli mashg'ulot va qiziqishlaringizni bo'lishishingiz va ehtimol butun dunyo bo'ylab do'stlar orttirishingiz mumkin. Bundan tashqari, e-mail mashhur, chunki u xat yuborishdan tezroq va telefon suhbatidan arzonroq.

points.en: On the other hand, the Internet has several disadvantages. Firstly, with so much information available, finding what you want can take you hours. Multimedia web pages with photographs, music and video are attractive, but they make downloading slow and boring. Finally, there is too much advertising instead of real information. As for Internet friendships, sitting at home in front of a computer making 'chat friends' is not the same as actually meeting people.
points.uz: Boshqa tomondan, Internetning bir nechta kamchiliklari bor. Birinchidan, shunchalik ko'p ma'lumot bilan xohlagan narsangizni topish soatlab vaqt olishi mumkin. Surat, musiqa va videoli multimedia veb-sahifalar jozibali, lekin ular yuklab olishni sekin va zerikarli qiladi. Nihoyat, haqiqiy ma'lumot o'rniga juda ko'p reklama bor. Internet do'stligiga kelsak, uyda kompyuter oldida o'tirib 'chat do'stlari' orttirish odamlarni haqiqatan uchratish bilan bir xil emas.

points.en: In conclusion, the Internet obviously has both good and bad points. Fortunately, the system is improving all the time, and any problems which still exist can be solved. Whether we like it or not, the Internet is here to stay, so we have to make the best possible use of it.
points.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, Internetning aniq yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bor. Baxtimizga, tizim doimo yaxshilanmoqda va hali mavjud bo'lgan har qanday muammoni hal qilish mumkin. Xohlaymizmi-yo'qmi, Internet qolish uchun keldi, shuning uchun undan iloji boricha yaxshi foydalanishimiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article in Ex. 13 again and make notes about the Pros and Cons of using the Internet. Then, use your notes to talk about the topic.
exercises.instructionUz: 13-mashqdagi maqolani yana o'qing va Internetdan foydalanishning afzallik va kamchiliklari haqida qaydlar yozing. Keyin qaydlaringizdan mavzu haqida gapirish uchun foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  PROS: latest info at any time;
  faster than libraries; on-line
  shopping - best price, saves
  time & money; newsgroups - share
  hobbies, make friends; e-mail -
  fast & cheap

  CONS: finding info takes hours;
  multimedia pages - slow
  downloading; too much
  advertising; chat friends ≠ real
  friends

  ⚠ Bog'lovchilar bilan: Firstly,
  Also, On the other hand, In
  conclusion.
exercises.exampleEn: Using the Internet has many advantages. Firstly, the latest information is available at any time. Also, on-line shopping saves time and money, and e-mail is fast and cheap.
exercises.exampleUz: Internetdan foydalanishning ko'p afzalliklari bor. Birinchidan, eng so'nggi ma'lumot istalgan vaqtda mavjud. Shuningdek, onlayn xarid vaqt va pulni tejaydi, e-mail esa tez va arzon.
modelAnswers: On the other hand, there are some disadvantages. Finding what you want can take hours, multimedia pages make downloading slow, and there is too much advertising. Chat friends are not the same as real friends.
In conclusion, the Internet has both good and bad points, but it is here to stay, so we should make the best use of it.
modelAnswersUz: Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi kamchiliklar bor. Xohlagan narsangizni topish soatlab vaqt olishi mumkin, multimedia sahifalar yuklab olishni sekinlashtiradi va juda ko'p reklama bor. Chat do'stlari haqiqiy do'stlar bilan bir xil emas.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, Internetning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bor, lekin u qolish uchun keldi, shuning uchun undan yaxshi foydalanishimiz kerak.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Afzallik va kamchiliklarni muhokama qilish qoliplari.

patterns.formula: One of the disadvantages of + -ING is that + GAP.
patterns.exampleEn: One of the disadvantages of using the Internet is that downloading is slow.
patterns.exampleUz: Internetdan foydalanishning kamchiliklaridan biri - yuklab olish sekin.

patterns.formula: I agree, but on the other hand, + GAP.
patterns.exampleEn: I agree, but on the other hand, the latest information is available at any time.
patterns.exampleUz: Roziman, lekin boshqa tomondan, eng so'nggi ma'lumot istalgan vaqtda mavjud.

patterns.formula: It is much faster to + FE'L than to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: It is much faster to surf the net than to travel to libraries.
patterns.exampleUz: Internetda kezish kutubxonalarga borishdan ancha tez.

patterns.formula: Whether we like it or not, + GAP.
patterns.exampleEn: Whether we like it or not, the Internet is here to stay.
